verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration services provider with case workflows, status dashboards, and People Ops integration, so a natural-language command interface is a plausible capability for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents no chat, assistant, or natural-language operation of the product. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI both returned 404, so there is also no machine-facing surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
